/usr/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import asyncio,os,time,sys
import edge_tts
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');from audit import record
async def main():
 st=time.time()
 try:
  comm=edge_tts.Communicate('先听一听，藏在枝叶间的鸟鸣。',voice='zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural',rate='-5%',proxy=os.environ['HTTPS_PROXY'])
  await comm.save('/workspace/scratch/voice_test.mp3')
  record('tts_test','Test Xiaoxiao Mandarin neural voice at -5 percent natural synthesis rate',st,result='success',input='Self-authored text only; no source audio/video uploaded',proxy='HTTPS_PROXY')
  print('Speech generated')
 except Exception as e:
  record('tts_test','Test Xiaoxiao Mandarin neural voice',st,result='failure',error=str(e));print(type(e).__name__,str(e))
asyncio.run(main())
PY"
